topics.label: Introduction to the Lecture on Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and outlines how previously introduced immune components integrate to drive the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition via Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system identifies infections and cellular injury through molecular patterns and dedicated receptor signaling systems.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cascade, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how activated sentinel cells direct immune cell trafficking and lymphatic drainage to fight infection, along with the risks of uncontrolled systemic inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how acute inflammation is terminated, how tissues are repaired, and what occurs when unresolved inflammation leads to chronic disease or granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and introduces the topic of the next lecture.
